ai.definition: Terahertz 6G Sensing & Comms is a next-generation wireless technology that operates at very high frequencies (100 GHz to 3 THz) to enable both communication and environmental sensing simultaneously.
ai.howItWorks: This technology uses terahertz-band transceivers and reconfigurable surfaces to test the integration of communication and sensing functionalities. It involves shaping beams around obstacles for efficient data transmission and real-time environment monitoring.
ai.problemSolved: Current wireless technologies struggle with bandwidth limitations and environmental awareness, especially in densely populated areas or complex environments. Terahertz 6G Sensing & Comms addresses these issues by providing higher data rates and enhanced sensing capabilities.
ai.manufacturing: The manufacturing process for terahertz components is still in its infancy, involving the development of advanced materials and fabrication techniques to produce reliable transceivers and reconfigurable surfaces.
ai.buildProcess: Laboratory testing focuses on developing prototypes that can simultaneously transmit data and sense the environment. This involves fine-tuning the design and functionality of terahertz devices to ensure they can operate effectively in various conditions.
ai.costDrivers: The high cost drivers include the development of specialized materials, advanced fabrication techniques, and rigorous testing requirements for terahertz components.
ai.lifecycleOutlook: expected to transition from lab research to early commercialization within the next decade as foundational technologies mature.
ai.regulation: Current regulatory frameworks are not fully equipped to handle terahertz technology, which may require new standards and guidelines for spectrum allocation and device operation.
ai.risks: Technological challenges include signal attenuation, interference with existing systems, and the need for specialized infrastructure. Additionally, there are concerns around data privacy and security due to increased sensing capabilities.
ai.profitability: The potential market for terahertz 6G Sensing & Comms is vast, but profitability will depend on successful commercialization and widespread adoption of related technologies.
ai.futureDevelopment: Future development will focus on improving the efficiency and reliability of terahertz devices, expanding their applications in various industries, and addressing regulatory and security concerns.

glossary.def: A band of the electromagnetic spectrum between microwaves and infrared light, with frequencies ranging from 100 GHz to 3 THz.
An electronic device that can both transmit and receive signals over a communication channel.
A type of material or structure capable of changing its properties in response to external stimuli, often used for adaptive antenna arrays.

subsystems.name: Terahertz transceiver chips
subsystems.role: generate, modulate and receive signals at frequencies from 0.1 to 10 THz.

subsystems.name: Antenna arrays
subsystems.role: radiate and capture terahertz waves with high gain and steerable beams.

subsystems.name: Reconfigurable intelligent surfaces
subsystems.role: reflect and redirect signals around obstacles to extend coverage.
parts: tunable metamaterial elements (varactors, liquid crystal or MEMS)

subsystems.name: Joint communication and sensing processing
subsystems.role: use one waveform for both data transmission and radar-like detection of objects.

subsystems.name: Network and edge integration
subsystems.role: connect terahertz access points to fibre backhaul and edge computing.

subsystems.name: Test and measurement
subsystems.role: characterise channels and validate prototypes in the lab.
parts: vector network analysers up to terahertz frequencies

buildSteps.title: Design terahertz circuits
buildSteps.detail: Use semiconductor process design kits to lay out transistors, mixers and oscillators that operate above 100 GHz.

buildSteps.title: Fabricate chips
buildSteps.detail: Run wafers through a foundry, then dice and package them with low-loss interconnects.

buildSteps.title: Integrate antennas
buildSteps.detail: Attach or fabricate antenna arrays on the chip or package, with sub-millimetre spacing to avoid grating lobes.

buildSteps.title: Build reconfigurable intelligent surfaces
buildSteps.detail: Create large arrays of tunable elements on a printed circuit board or glass substrate, with control lines to each element.

buildSteps.title: Develop signal processing
buildSteps.detail: Write algorithms that generate joint waveforms, estimate channels, and separate sensing from communication data.

buildSteps.title: Assemble a testbed
buildSteps.detail: Connect chips, antennas, reconfigurable surfaces and baseband units; synchronise clocks and calibrate the system.

buildSteps.title: Run lab trials
buildSteps.detail: Measure data throughput, latency, sensing resolution and range in indoor and outdoor settings.

buildSteps.title: Standardise
buildSteps.detail: Contribute measurement results and designs to standards bodies such as ITU-R and 3GPP to define 6G requirements.

buildSteps.title: Pilot deployment
buildSteps.detail: Install in a factory, stadium or campus to test real-world performance and reliability.

prerequisites.why: transistors and amplifiers exist in labs but lack power efficiency and mass production.
sampling rates of tens of gigasamples per second are needed to process terahertz signals.
international allocation for frequencies above 100 GHz is not yet settled.
small prototypes exist, but large-area, low-cost production is not proven.

prerequisites.tech: Standardisation for integrated sensing and communication
prerequisites.why: standards bodies are only beginning to study joint sensing and communication.
output power is low, which limits range and coverage.

pathway.milestone: sub-terahertz lab links achieving hundreds of gigabits per second over a few metres, with joint sensing demonstrations
pathway.unlocks: proof that terahertz can carry data and sense the environment.

pathway.milestone: 5G-Advanced and early 6G standards include integrated sensing; reconfigurable-surface field trials in controlled environments
pathway.unlocks: regulatory and industrial momentum for the next generation.

pathway.milestone: pilot deployments in factories, stadiums and transport hubs
pathway.unlocks: real-world data on reliability and cost.

pathway.milestone: commercial 6G networks with native terahertz access and sensing
pathway.unlocks: ultra-high-capacity wireless and pervasive environmental sensing.
